milestones.title: Start Security+ (or ISC2 CC) and aim to pass by early in Semester 1
milestones.detail: NZ graduate listings name these as a head start. Security+ is about US$425; ISC2 CC is US$199 plus US$50 a year (its free programme closed in May 2026). Take one, not both. The Security+ exam-prep checkpoints are in Phase 1, and you can start them before week 1.

milestones.title: NZ-format CV, LinkedIn and a GitHub with 2–3 security projects
milestones.detail: Include one detection or log-pipeline project that shows your data engineering background. Your first application round opens weeks after arrival.

milestones.title: Shortlist employers that accept your visa type
milestones.detail: Use the eligibility tracker below. Many programmes are citizen/PR only; target the ones that are not.

milestones.title: Join the AUT CSI club, register with Summer of Tech, book an AUT careers appointment
milestones.detail: Do all three in your first two weeks.

milestones.title: Apply in the summer internship round
milestones.detail: Big 4 and many corporates recruit interns and graduates in one March–April window. Confirm with each employer that an 18-month master's counts as penultimate year.

milestones.title: Find part-time IT or service desk work within your visa hours
milestones.detail: Entry IT experience is a common step into SOC roles; Fujitsu has advertised a part-time junior SOC role of up to 24 hours a week.

milestones.title: Compete in the NZ Cyber Security Challenge (dates vary; check the site)
milestones.detail: Sponsors have included CyberCX, Deloitte and SecurityLit.

milestones.title: Attend Kawaiicon in Wellington and play its mini CTF
milestones.detail: The 2026 edition ran 30–31 October; check 2027 dates.

milestones.title: Summer internship (full-time is allowed in scheduled holidays)
milestones.detail: If no internship, run a substantial portfolio project and keep applying to off-cycle roles.

milestones.title: Apply in the graduate round during your final semester
milestones.detail: Deloitte notes mid-year finishers may be able to start before the February intake.

milestones.title: Finish the degree and apply for the post-study work visa
milestones.detail: A Level 9 master's can lead to a 3-year open work visa. Confirm current rules with Immigration NZ.

milestones.title: First year of work: SC-500 for cloud security, or PNPT then OSCP for pentesting
milestones.detail: SC-200, eJPT and BTL1 are scheduled during the degree. Pentest roles usually ask for 2–3 years’ experience; a SOC or graduate role is the usual first step. Check residence points with Immigration NZ or a licensed adviser.

employers.name: Deloitte NZ
employers.note: Accepts graduates holding a 3-year post-study work visa; interns need NZ work rights.

employers.name: KPMG NZ
employers.note: Cyber graduate listing included temporary work visa holders; NZD 60–65k.

employers.name: PwC NZ
employers.note: Welcomes work-visa applicants subject to criteria; some listings say citizen/PR only.

employers.name: Grant Thornton NZ
employers.note: Needs a legal right to work and to be living in NZ.

employers.name: Air New Zealand
employers.note: Final-year or recent grads; NZD 54–72k. Eligibility not stated in the listing seen.

employers.name: Fujitsu NZ
employers.note: Part-time junior SOC role advertised up to 24 h/week; some SOC roles need clearance.

employers.name: Canva
employers.note: Needs AU/NZ working rights; no visa sponsorship for early-talent roles.

employers.name: Summer of Tech employers
employers.note: Open to students enrolled at an NZ tertiary institution; very competitive.

employers.name: ZX Security
employers.note: Always open to talent; usually wants pentest experience and certs.

employers.name: Pulse Security
employers.note: Must already be in NZ; strong written English.

employers.name: CyberCX Academy & graduate
employers.note: NZ citizen, NZ PR or Australian citizen only. Its community events are open to all.

employers.name: ANZ
employers.note: Internships citizen/PR; graduate programme allows only specified visas.

employers.name: Government, NZDF, GCSB/NZSIS
employers.note: Clearance needs a 5–15 year checkable background in NZ/AU/CA/UK/US; usually years away for new arrivals.
